cases.name: testOtherAbapDocWithPipe
cases.src:
CLASS any_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " |
    " any | text
    " any text with | pipe character inside
    " any text ending with pipe character |
    " | any text starting with pipe character
    "! |
    "! any | text
    "! any text with | pipe character inside
    "! any text ending with pipe character |
    "! | any text starting with pipe character
    METHODS other_method
      IMPORTING !iv_any_param   TYPE i
                !iv_other_param TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_any_exception.
ENDCLASS.
cases.exp:
CLASS any_class DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " |
    " any | text
    " any text with | pipe character inside
    " any text ending with pipe character |
    " | any text starting with pipe character
    "! |
    "! any | text
    "! any text with | pipe character inside
    "! any text ending with pipe character |
    "! | any text starting with pipe character
    METHODS other_method
      IMPORTING !iv_any_param   TYPE i
                !iv_other_param TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_any_exception.
ENDCLASS.
